name: Action Over Deliberation
description:
When your companions debate how to handle a dangerous situation in your presence, your patience wears thin. When someone other than you suggests a second possible course of action, start a 1-minute timer (tracking real-world time, not in-game time).

If the group agrees upon a plan before the timer runs out, choose a skill. For the next 10 minutes, your rolls with that skill are favored.

If the timer runs out before the group agrees on a plan, choose one:

  • You must charge ahead recklessly, ignoring companions’ concerns.

  • You must break something, make a loud noise, or reveal sensitive information.

  • You check two Conditions.

When you resolve one of these effects, if the group is still debating, start another timer.

Describe how your temper rises.
